content.short: Space and Time is a decentralized data warehouse that links on-chain and off-chain data to power smart contract use cases.
content.description: Space and Time (SxT) is a decentralized data warehouse preloaded with indexed blockchain data from major chains. It lets you join tamper-evident on-chain data with your own off-chain datasets using a simple SQL interface, then publish the results to smart contracts, dapps, dashboards, BI tools, and ML models. Proof of SQL, a novel zk-cryptography approach, demonstrates that queries run in SxT are verifiably tamper-proof. This enables sub-second queries and enterprise-scale analytics in a tamper-proof, blockchain-anchored workflow.

resources.title: AI Agents Need Data Before They Can Transact
resources.tldr: An agent that cannot verify what it is looking at cannot safely act on it. Frames verifiable data as the prerequisite rather than an enhancement.

resources.title: Activity-Based Rewards Instead of Yield
resources.tldr: Paying for what people do rather than for what they lock up. Short, and a useful counterpoint to the standard incentive design.
